sources.name: USGS 3DEP elevation
sources.attribution: Map services and data available from U.S. Geological Survey, National Geospatial Program.
sources.query: https://elevation.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/3DEPElevation/ImageServer/getSamples getSamples multipoint, 416 points (lon, lat WGS84), bilinear

provenance.modifications: US 1 ways stitched along the travel carriageway, heading Gaussian-smoothed (sigma 35 m), positions re-integrated from heading, resampled at 2 m; long straights compressed (753 m to 60%, 663 m to 60%, 762 m to 60%; bridges kept); land elevation from 3DEP low-pass filtered (sigma 60 m), floored at 1 m; bridge decks synthesized (3DEP is bare earth): 4 m deck, 12 m x 420 m hump on bridges over 800 m (not measured); lanes simplified to one each way plus shoulders

meta.notes: Baked by tools/gis from osm-keys-bahia-honda.json. Real US 1 geometry, gameplay-fied (see provenance.modifications). Regenerate with the bake; never hand-edit.
